user.title: Intercom
user.description: Set the defaults used by the intercom.broadcast service. You can override most of these per call.

data.wait_timeout: Max seconds to wait for playback
data.start_timeout: Max seconds to wait for playback to start

data_description.wait_timeout: How long a single announcement is allowed to take before it is given up on.
data_description.start_timeout: How long to wait for a speaker to show any sign of playing before reporting that nothing was heard. Sonos needs several seconds to buffer.
data_description.max_attempts: How many times each speaker or notify target is tried before it is reported as failed.
data_description.unmute: A muted speaker accepts an announcement and plays it silently. Unmuting first (and re-muting afterwards) prevents that.

data.wait_timeout: Max seconds to wait for playback
data.start_timeout: Max seconds to wait for playback to start

data_description.wait_timeout: How long a single announcement is allowed to take before it is given up on.
data_description.start_timeout: How long to wait for a speaker to show any sign of playing before reporting that nothing was heard. Sonos needs several seconds to buffer.
data_description.max_attempts: How many times each speaker or notify target is tried before it is reported as failed.
data_description.unmute: A muted speaker accepts an announcement and plays it silently. Unmuting first (and re-muting afterwards) prevents that.

broadcast.name: Broadcast
broadcast.description: Speak a message over media players (TTS) and/or send it to notify targets, and report what was actually played.

message.name: Message
message.description: The text to speak and/or notify.

players.name: Players
players.description: Media players to speak the message on.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Volume to set for the announcement (0-100%). Omit to leave volume unchanged.

notify.name: Notify targets
notify.description: Notify services to send the message to, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone.

title.name: Title
title.description: Notification title. Defaults to the configured title.

engine.name: TTS engine
engine.description: TTS engine entity to use. Defaults to the configured engine.

restore_volume.name: Restore volume
restore_volume.description: Restore each player's original volume after the announcement.

verify.name: Confirm playback
verify.description: Wait for evidence that each speaker really started playing before reporting it as played.

critical.name: Critical
critical.description: Retry speakers that produced no sound and raise an error if any target was not delivered.

max_attempts.name: Max attempts
max_attempts.description: How many times to try each target before giving up.
